purpose: Isolated, sanitized records for the customer-app E2E (A08 C14/C09). Nothing here touches a real outlet, a real customer, or the shared catalogue: the products are CLONES of existing orderable items placed on a NEW test-only branch whose petpoojaStoreId is deliberately null, so no KOT can ever reach a kitchen that is not ours to ring.
whyNotNullStoreId: 5639/31z58ciw0h (demo) is the ONLY outlet carrying a petpoojaStoreId, so it is the only KOT-capable branch. An order on this test branch therefore exercises checkout -> payment -> order-state -> courier-quote WITHOUT any POS write, which is what C14 requires. The KOT leg is exercised separately and explicitly on the demo outlet via the staff route, and recorded as such.

substitutions.<runId>: every record id below carries it, which is what makes cleanup exact rather than a broad query

doc.name: E2E Test Kitchen (NOT A REAL OUTLET)

products.sourceRule: CLONE the price and structure of an existing orderable product; never invent a price, never carry a "0" price through, and never copy a vendor in_stock value (see inStockRule).
products.inStockRule: Set inStock EXPLICITLY true on the clone. This is the whole point of cloning: availability becomes a fact we author, so the E2E never depends on the unresolved vendor in_stock encoding (C07/C14).

controlledContact.note: This number already appears in the repo's existing hermetic test fixtures. It is NOT a fabricated real person's number, and it must never be replaced by one (C13).

orderIdConvention.note: per-run unique, so a rerun can never be mistaken for a previous run's order and cleanup is exact

catalogueBranchCloning.mutationOfSource: NONE - the source docs are only read; the clones are new documents
catalogueBranchCloning.orderableCatalogueRewrite: not required for this E2E and still not authorised

never: a broad or unscoped query delete
any existing branchId, productId or orderId that does not carry this run's id

safety.razorpayMode: TEST keys only (the configured key id is rzp_test_*)
safety.courierBooking: none - a quote only, on the already-authorised Borzo TEST host
safety.pii: none - controlled test contact only, no export of any real customer record

stillBlockedBeforeThisCanRun: RAZORPAY_WEBHOOK_SECRET - without it the signed-webhook leg cannot be exercised and a staging boot fails its own gate
an explicitly reviewed app artifact / preview target for the client half (C15) - the deployed runtime is dev
the vendor in_stock encoding, for the vendor acceptance cases only (NOT for this fixture, which authors availability explicitly)
